<quote by="Proposed: Mitwold, Seconded: Upwold">Construct a money sinecure in Hay, Mitwold. Costs 10 wains of white granite and 30 crowns. Self-funded by Carefoot and Shaw Trading Company. Appointed as the 'Kennelmaster of Hay's Home for Wayward Dogs' with tenure by senators of the Marches.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Golden Downs, [[Mitwold]]
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 387YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 wains of white granite
* 30 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Kennels_of_Hay}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Kennelmaster of Hay]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of the senators of [[the Marches]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE
